constructive_counterexample.local_reproduction: Deterministic reconstruction of the current _receipt/make_grant predicates confirms the forged references are syntactically admissible.
constructive_counterexample.why_shape_passes: Both blob strings satisfy the current 40-to-64 lowercase-hex regex and every required Boolean is true; _receipt performs no file/blob dereference.

critical_path_effect.relation_to_composition_root3: This removes a false-positive proof transport route. It does not itself prove P1/P2 composition invariants; it makes any future composition receipt causally trustworthy enough to be used by the effect gate.

finding.statement: The current broker validates receipt-reference shape and duplicated Boolean claims but does not dereference the path, verify the referenced Git blob bytes, or derive the required claims from those verified bytes. Therefore make_grant/admit can accept references to nonexistent or unrelated receipts when the caller supplies syntactically valid blob text and required true flags.

R1_RECEIPT_BYTE_RESOLUTION: resolve receipt path inside an allowed canonical repository root with path traversal and symlink escape rejected
read exact bytes and enforce a bounded size
compute the Git blob object ID from exact bytes and require equality with git_blob_sha
parse the verified bytes and derive required claims from the receipt itself rather than caller-duplicated booleans
R2_SCOPE_BINDING: require the verified receipt semantics to bind the relevant mission/capsule/request or explicitly verified superset scope
reject a valid but unrelated receipt
R3_EFFECT_CARRIER_ENFORCEMENT: the side-effect carrier must require the strict byte-verified verdict before any external mutation
no alternate execution path may treat ALLOW_PRECOMMIT alone as final authorization
R4_ADVERSARIAL_TESTS: valid blob with false or missing semantic claim

proof_from_source: _receipt validates git_blob_sha only by lowercase-hex length regex
_receipt checks required_true fields only in the supplied mapping
_receipt rejects extra keys but never resolves path or object bytes
make_grant embeds the accepted mappings into the grant hash
admit recomputes make_grant against the same supplied mappings
therefore self-consistency of the grant does not establish existence or truth of the referenced evidence
